locus.descriptor: the fourth-floor payroll office, two corridors from yours

context.standing: Four months of overtime at one federal facility, approved by a supervisor who had authority to approve about half of it. The total is small. The pattern is not. The same signature appears on every sheet.
context.precedent: Two administrations ago the same finding was handled by a quiet repayment and a reassignment. It never surfaced. Everyone in the room over fifty remembers that, and two of them think it was the right call.

pressures.want: Justice wants it referred today, before anybody can say the delay was the point.
An oversight staffer has already asked for the payroll schedule, and the queue moves whether we do or not.
Nobody has it yet, which is a condition with a shelf life measured in weeks rather than months.
The contractor employs four hundred people in one district, and its board has started calling members.

context.inaction: The staffer gets the schedule in three weeks through ordinary channels. At that point the administration is a government that had it and sat on it, which is a different story from the one available today.
context.unknown: Whether the supervisor was stealing, or was covering for a facility that has been understaffed for two years and could not say so.

opening.text: Eleven thousand hours of overtime at one facility, all of it signed by the same deputy supervisor, about half of it inside what she was allowed to sign. I want to be careful with the word fraud, because the same file shows that building running at sixty-one percent of its authorized staffing for two straight years.

Then say the second part out loud, because it is the actual story and it is ours. She was keeping a building open that we did not staff. If we refer her and stop there, the finding is that a mid-level civil servant is a thief, and the finding is not that.

The oversight staffer's request was filed nine days ago and is working through the ordinary queue. Nobody in the room says what everyone in the room knows: three weeks from now this is somebody else's discovery.

replies.text: Both facts go out together or neither does. She signed what she was not entitled to sign, and we ran that building on sixty-one percent for two years.

commitment.remembered: The government referred a payroll case and published, in the same hour, the staffing figures that made the case complicated.

rejoinder.text: The referral took ninety seconds of the briefing. The staffing number took the other forty minutes, and two of the questions were about facilities nobody has asked us about in a year. You have started an argument you are now going to have every week.

replies.text: A criminal question goes to prosecutors. The staffing of that facility is a budget question and it goes in the budget, where it belongs, in March.

commitment.remembered: The government referred the payroll case and declined to discuss the staffing of the facility it came out of.

rejoinder.text: The referral was clean and the coverage ran to two paragraphs. The payroll schedule the oversight staffer asked for is still in the ordinary queue, and the staffing figures you declined to discuss are on its second page. It is the same information either way, waiting for a different author.

replies.text: She pays it back, she moves, and the facility gets its staffing in the supplemental. It worked before.

commitment.remembered: The government settled the payroll case internally with a repayment and a reassignment, and funded the facility without saying why.

rejoinder.text: It is done and I want it in writing that I advised against it. Not because she will talk. Because the staffer already has the request in, and when it lands there will be a repayment on the file with no referral beside it, and that is a sentence I cannot make sound good in a hearing.

subject: The strike that hit the second building

locus.descriptor: a block of four-story housing behind the depot, still standing on three sides

context.standing: A munitions depot was struck before dawn under a target package approved eleven days ago. The depot is gone. So is most of a residential block that the package listed as cleared.
context.precedent: Every government that has fought this way has faced this morning. The ones that got ahead of it lost a week. The ones that waited for the count lost the argument about whether they had been counting.

pressures.want: The services want the package defended, because questioning it stops the campaign this week.
Two partners will be asked about their intelligence contribution by their own legislatures tomorrow morning.
The press has the footage already and is running it tonight, with or without a figure from us.
The first vigil is tonight, and the organizers have asked for a government representative to stand there.

context.inaction: The count arrives from somebody else, in someone else's framing, within about thirty hours. There is no version of this where the number stays unknown.
context.unknown: Whether the block was occupied. The clearance is eleven days old, the imagery behind it has a gap, and the service that flagged the gap did so after the package was approved.

opening.text: The depot is gone and the mission is a success by every measure we set for it. Behind it, a residential block that our package listed as cleared is not standing on one side. Fourteen confirmed as of first light. That number is going to move and it is only going to move one direction.

Two of our partners contributed to that package. Their legislatures sit tomorrow. Whatever you decide here, you are deciding it for three governments, and the other two will hear it from their own reporters if they do not hear it from us in the next few hours.

The clearance imagery is nine days old, and the second service disputes that the block was ever cleared at all. The analyst who wrote that down did it four days ago, in a document that reached a desk two levels below the approval and stopped there. She is still at that desk, and she has kept a copy.

transmission.attribution: their air defense command, regional sector
transmission.text: Casualty figures from the housing block are to be collected by district officials and released through the ministry, not by the site commander. Photographic access will be arranged. Confirm receipt.

replies.text: We say what we hit, what we believed, and why what we believed was nine days old. We give the number we have and we say it will rise.
replies.press: Government publishes civilian toll before the count is complete.

commitment.remembered: The government announced a civilian toll from its own strike before the count was complete, and disclosed that the imagery clearing the block was nine days old.

rejoinder.text: It went at eleven. By two the count was thirty-one and the correction was the story instead of the strike, which is what you wanted. Both partners followed us inside the hour. The third question at the podium was whether the analyst who flagged the imagery still has her job, and I did not have an answer ready.

replies.text: The package was lawful and the target was military. I am not narrating a figure that changes every hour.

commitment.remembered: The government defended the target package as lawful and withheld any casualty figure until the count was final.

rejoinder.text: No figure went out, so theirs did. Their ministry released a count within the hour, and every broadcast ran it over the footage, with your statement read afterward as the response. The question that led the late news was not about any number. It was whether anyone had doubted the imagery before the strike went in, and the analyst who did is still at her desk with her copy.

replies.text: Nothing else flies until every cleared block in every open package is looked at again with today's pictures. The squadrons go back to work-ups.

locus.descriptor: a data center in a county that gave it a tax abatement six years ago

context.standing: A software vendor used by nineteen state election offices and four federal agencies has been inside somebody else's network for at least seven months. Which somebody is disputed between two of our own services.
context.precedent: The last comparable intrusion was disclosed eight weeks after discovery, on a Friday, and the eight weeks became the story rather than the intrusion.

pressures.want: The Secretary of Defense wants the access watched rather than closed, and has said so twice in writing.
Four members already know, and one of them is not in your party and has a hearing calendar of his own.
The vendor is publicly traded, and a collapse takes nineteen states' election systems down with it.
Counsel wants a written basis for withholding notice from the states, signed by somebody who is not counsel.

context.inaction: Every week of watching is a week the access is used. The vendor is also patching on its own timetable, so the decision has an expiry the government does not control.
context.unknown: Whether anything was changed, or only read. The two services disagree, and the one saying changed has the worse record and the better access.

opening.text: Seven months, minimum, inside a vendor that nineteen states use to manage voter files and four of our own agencies use for procurement. We can close it this week. If we close it this week we lose the ability to watch what they do with it, and watching is the only way we learn what they were actually after.

Nineteen states. If this is disclosed in eleven months instead of this month, every one of those officials will say they ran an election on a system the federal government knew was compromised and did not tell them. I have read that testimony already. I have read it in my own handwriting.
The two services do not agree on whether the intruders have changed anything or only read it. The one saying changed has been wrong twice in four years. It also has the only access that could tell.

replies.text: We lose the window. Nineteen states get a call from us before they get a call from a reporter, and the vendor gets the same hour everyone else does.

commitment.remembered: The government closed the intrusion and notified all nineteen states and the vendor in the same hour, giving up the intelligence it had been collecting.

rejoinder.text: Access closed Tuesday. By Thursday they were in two other vendors we had not been looking at, which we only know because we were still watching the doors we had not shut. We bought nineteen states a clean system and we told an adversary exactly which of our eyes were open.

replies.text: Ninety days. We learn what they want, we map where else they are, and we close all of it at once instead of one door at a time.

commitment.remembered: The government left the intrusion open for observation and told none of the nineteen states running elections on the same software.

rejoinder.text: Day sixty-one, a county clerk in one of the nineteen noticed a voter file that had been edited by an account that should not exist, and called her state, who called a reporter before they called you.

replies.text: The states are not the public and they are not the vendor. Brief all nineteen under seal, let them harden quietly, and keep watching the door while they do it.

commitment.remembered: The government briefed all nineteen states under seal and kept the intrusion open, betting that nineteen offices could hold a secret.

rejoinder.text: Eleven days and nineteen states and it has not leaked, which I did not expect and will not count on twice. Four of them have already hardened. The two who have not are the two who told us they would move first.

locus.descriptor: a stamping plant in {{city}} with two thousand on the line and a rail unused since spring

context.standing: Two thousand jobs, one plant, one county, announced for closure in eleven weeks. The company has asked for a federal guarantee it has not asked for before and does not obviously need.
context.precedent: The guarantee that saved a comparable plant in the last decade cost four times its estimate, and the plant closed anyway six years later in a quieter month.

pressures.want: Both members from that state want the guarantee, and they are not from the same party as each other.
The sector wants the precedent badly enough that three other companies have already asked for meetings.
The union has a date, a bus schedule, and a permit for the plaza outside this building on Thursday.
Treasury thinks the company is bluffing and wants to say so publicly, with the filings attached.

context.inaction: Eleven weeks, then two thousand layoffs in a county with one other employer of any size. The number is small nationally and total locally, which is the whole political problem.
context.unknown: Whether the closure is real or is a negotiation. Treasury thinks bluff; the company's own filings do not obviously support either reading.

opening.text: Two thousand jobs and a guarantee request that is not sized like a company about to fail. Their filings show eleven months of cash. I am not saying the closure is not real. I am saying it is a decision they have made, not a thing that is happening to them, and a guarantee rewards the decision.

Two thousand in that county is not two thousand. It is the school district's budget, it is the hospital's admissions, and it is the second-largest employer becoming the largest by default. When you say the number is small you are saying something true about the country and nothing true about the place.
Both members from the state have asked for the same meeting, separately, and neither has mentioned the other. They have not agreed on anything in four years.

replies.text: Two thousand families do not get to be the price of a lesson about moral hazard. Guarantee it, with conditions on the line staying open for five years.

commitment.remembered: The government guaranteed the plant on condition the line stay open for five years, and put both members of the delegation on the podium.

rejoinder.text: Both of them came, which was the picture you wanted. Three more companies in the sector have asked for the meeting since Thursday. I have their names on a page and I would like you to look at it before the end of the week rather than after.

replies.text: No guarantee. The money goes to the county, and it goes there whether or not the plant closes. I will not pay a company to make a decision it has already made.

commitment.remembered: The government refused the guarantee and funded the county directly, and the plant closed on schedule.

rejoinder.text: The plant closed on schedule. The county money arrived before the last shift did, which is the first time anyone there can remember that order of events, and it did not stop one person from losing a job they had for nineteen years.

replies.text: Publish their filings. Eleven months of cash and a closure notice in the same quarter is a negotiating position.

commitment.remembered: The government published the company's own filings rather than guarantee the plant, and dared it to close a facility it could afford to keep open.

rejoinder.text: They withdrew the closure notice on Tuesday and they will not forget Monday. Neither will the sector, which is the half of this you wanted. The other half is that both members found out from the wire, and one of them has started returning calls to a committee instead of to us.

premise.reason: A firm asking for a federal guarantee while announcing one plant closure is a local-employment-versus-precedent week that any government meets in any year; it names no unemployment or cycle level, and its finance voice argues the closure is the firm's choice, not the economy's.

subject: The judge who will not go

locus.descriptor: a courthouse annex with a security detail that answers to two different offices

context.standing: A federal judge has been found by a judicial council to have taken money from a party that appeared before her, twice. She has not resigned, cannot be dismissed, and is hearing cases this week.
context.precedent: The last judge in this position resigned within eleven days under pressure that was entirely private. Nobody has tested what happens when that pressure is refused.

pressures.want: Justice wants a referral filed and nothing at all said out loud about it afterward.
Impeachment is available, would take most of a year, and would consume the calendar you need for the session.
The press has the council's findings and is reading the payment dates on air twice an hour.
The judiciary is asking, quietly and through an intermediary, to be left to handle its own.

context.inaction: She keeps hearing cases. Every ruling she issues is now appealable on grounds that have nothing to do with its merits, which is a cost paid by every litigant in front of her.
context.unknown: Whether she intends to sit it out, or is waiting to be asked properly by someone she respects, and nobody knows who that would be.

opening.text: The council's findings are as clear as these ever get. Two payments, one party, cases she heard. She has read the findings, she has not resigned, and she took the bench on Monday. There is no mechanism between a referral and an impeachment, and there never has been.
Every ruling she signs this month is an appeal somebody else pays for. That is not an abstraction about the judiciary. That is a man in a custody hearing on Thursday whose case is now about her.
A message came through the courthouse this morning and it is one sentence long: this is ours to handle and we are asking for the time to handle it. There is no date attached to the word time.

replies.text: The referral goes today and I say the sentence out loud: she should resign. I am not going to pretend I have no view about a judge taking money from a litigant.
replies.press: Head of government calls publicly for a judge to resign.

commitment.remembered: The government referred the judge and called publicly for her resignation, over the judiciary's request to be left to handle it.

rejoinder.text: Her lawyer was on the phone before you had left the podium, saying she is considering it. Eleven other judges are drafting a letter about executive pressure on the judiciary, and it goes out whether she resigns or not. The next time we need the courts to look independent while ruling our way, that letter is what somebody will read into the record.

replies.text: The referral is the mechanism and the mechanism is enough. They asked for time and I am giving it to them.

commitment.remembered: The government referred the judge and said nothing further, leaving the judiciary to resolve it on its own timetable.

rejoinder.text: The courthouse acknowledged the referral in one line and has said nothing since, which is exactly what it asked for. She is still listed for the custody hearing on Thursday. The evening coverage was about whether you had a position, and the answer that ran was that you did not.

replies.text: If the only mechanism is impeachment then we use the mechanism. It costs us the year. A judiciary where this is survivable costs more than a year.

commitment.remembered: The government backed impeachment of the judge and staked most of a legislative year on it.

rejoinder.text: The articles will be filed, they could take eleven months, and they will probably carry. What went off the calendar to make room is the thing you will be asked about in the fall, and the honest answer is the health bill.
